common.name: Name
common.confirmDeleteBody: It will be moved to Trash and kept for 90 days.

onboarding.intro: Your personal finance manager — works fully offline, in Arabic and English.

dashboard.noTransactions: No transactions yet. Tap + to add your first one.

txn.splitMismatch: Split lines must add up exactly to the amount
txn.noRateWarning: No exchange rate is stored for {{currency}}. The transaction will be saved, but excluded from YER totals until you add a rate in Settings.
txn.sameCurrencyRule: Transfers are only possible between accounts of the same currency
txn.lockedDebt: This transaction belongs to a debt record. Manage it from the Debts screen so the debt balance stays correct. You can still delete it from the transactions list.
txn.lockedGoal: This transfer belongs to a savings goal. Manage it from the Savings goals screen. You can still delete it from the transactions list.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.openingHint: Enter the balance currently in this account (or the historical opening balance if you plan to import old transactions).
accounts.reconcileHint: Enter the real balance you actually have. The difference will be absorbed into the opening balance and logged.
accounts.cannotDelete: This account has transactions. Close it instead to preserve history.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add your first account to start.

categories.title: Categories
categories.inUse: This category is used by transactions; it will be archived instead of deleted.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.hint: 1 unit of the currency = how many Yemeni Rials. Rates are dated; each transaction keeps the rate that applied on its date.
rates.autoUpdatePending: Automatic online rate updates: pending connection

settings.title: Settings
settings.baseCurrencyNote: All consolidated totals are shown in Yemeni Rial (YER).
settings.backupPending: Cloud backup (Google Drive) and sync (Supabase): pending connection. Local export/import arrives in Stage 5.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.hint: Each profile has fully independent accounts, transactions and reports.

trash.title: Trash
trash.hint: Deleted records are kept for 90 days, then permanently removed.
trash.restoreFailed: Could not restore: the related account no longer exists

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.rollover: Roll unspent amount into the next period
budgets.empty: No budgets yet. Create one to watch your spending.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.linkedHint: Deposits move money into this account as a transfer — never counted as income.
goals.noEstimate: Not enough data to estimate completion

debts.title: Debts
debts.moveMoneyHint: Choose the account the money left from (lending) or arrived into (borrowing).
debts.repayNoAccount: No account — adjust the debt only
debts.empty: No debts recorded. That is a good thing!
debts.currencyMismatch: The account currency must match the debt currency

recurring.title: Recurring obligations
recurring.remindMode: Remind me, I will record it myself
recurring.empty: No recurring obligations yet. Add rent, bills, subscriptions or salaries.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.dailyReminder: You have not recorded any transaction today
notifications.backupNever: You have not made a backup yet — create one in Settings
notifications.backupStale: Your last backup was on {{date}} — consider a new one
notifications.syncFailed: Google Drive sync has failed several times — open Settings › Google Drive sync

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.noInsights: No insights yet — they appear once you have enough recorded data.

insight.spendingUp: Spending is {{pct}}% higher than at this point last period.
insight.spendingDown: Spending is {{pct}}% lower than at this point last period.
insight.categoryShare: {{category}} takes {{pct}}% of your spending this period.
insight.categoryUp: {{category}} spending rose {{pct}}% compared with last period.
insight.savingsRateUp: Your savings rate improved from {{from}}% to {{to}}%.
insight.savingsRateDown: Your savings rate dropped from {{from}}% to {{to}}%.
insight.obligationsVsBalance: Upcoming obligations ({{amount}}) exceed your available cash and bank balance.
insight.paceOverspend: At the current pace you may spend {{projected}}, above your budgets of {{budget}}. This is an estimate, not a certainty.

analytics.noAverage: Not enough history for an average

reports.title: Reports
reports.pdfHint: In the print dialog choose "Save as PDF".
reports.netWorthNote: Savings goals are not added separately — their money is already inside account balances.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Type at least 2 characters, or use filters.

calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.noRate: No stored exchange rate for {{currency}} — add one in Exchange rates.

investments.title: Investments
investments.accountHint: Buying/selling through an account moves the money; it is never counted as income or expense.
investments.priceHint: Prices are never fetched or guessed. The last price you record (on a buy, sale or price update) is used for the market value.
investments.insufficient: You cannot sell more than you hold on that date.
investments.conflict: This entry cannot be removed: a later sale depends on it. Remove the sale first.
investments.currencyMismatch: The account currency must match the investment currency.
investments.deleteHint: Deleting returns the money of linked buys/sales to their accounts. Everything goes to Trash for 90 days.

assets.title: Assets
assets.hint: Track things you own that are not accounts or investments. Don't add money already tracked in an account — it would be counted twice.

forecast.title: End-of-month forecast
forecast.noHistory: Not enough history yet for an average-based forecast.
forecast.receivableNote: Money others owe you is listed but not counted as expected income.

nwTrend.title: Net-worth trend
nwTrend.note: Reconstructed from your records and the exchange rate on each date.

cards.hint: Reorder, hide or show cards. Hidden cards can be restored any time.
cards.noBills: No bills due in the next 30 days.
cards.noDebts: No debt payments due in the next 30 days.

lock.title: Locked
lock.wrongPin: Wrong PIN. {{left}} attempt(s) before a waiting period.
lock.lockedOut: Too many attempts. Try again at {{time}}.
lock.biometricFailed: Fingerprint unlock failed. Use your PIN.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Protect the app with a PIN. Receipts and other attachments are then stored encrypted on this device.
security.recoveryWarning: Write the recovery password down and keep it safe. It is the only way back in if you forget the PIN — nobody, including us, can recover it.
security.invalidRecovery: Recovery password must be at least 8 characters
security.turnOffBody: Attachments will be decrypted and stored normally on this device.
security.lockOnLeave: The app also locks whenever you leave it (switch apps or turn off the screen).
security.bioUnsupported: Not supported on this device or browser (needs a built-in fingerprint/face sensor with WebAuthn PRF).
security.bioNoPrf: This browser cannot derive a key from the fingerprint sensor (WebAuthn PRF), so fingerprint unlock is not offered.
security.dbNote: Your financial records are stored in this browser's private storage, protected by Android's device encryption and the app lock screen. Attachments and backups are additionally encrypted by the app.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.passwordHint: You will need this password to restore. It is separate from your PIN, so the backup works on a new phone.
backup.restoreWarning: Restoring REPLACES all data on this device with the backup. Your app lock stays as it is.
backup.confirmRestore: Replace my data with this backup
backup.badPassword: Wrong password, or the file was modified.
backup.corrupt: The backup file is damaged and was not restored.
backup.notBackup: This is not a My Finance Manager backup file.
backup.newer: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first.
backup.exportHint: Readable files for Excel or other apps. NOT encrypted — store them carefully.
backup.cloudLink: Sync and back up daily to your own Google Drive, encrypted — tap to set up.

notifPrefs.title: Notification settings
notifPrefs.systemDenied: Notifications are blocked for this app in your browser/phone settings.
notifPrefs.limitation: Limitation of web apps: reminders and summaries are created when you open the app (they catch up on anything missed). Device notifications appear only while the app is open or in the background — the app cannot wake itself up when fully closed, because that requires a push server, which this app does not use.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.locked: Unlock the app to view or add attachments.

import.title: Import transactions
import.hint: Import historical transactions from a CSV file (from Excel, your bank, or this app’s export). Columns are matched automatically — check them below. Nothing is saved until you press Import.
import.signHint: Without a Type column, negative amounts are imported as expenses and positive amounts as income.

reasons.currency: currency does not match the account

import.doneTag: They are tagged #{{tag}} — filter by this tag to review or delete the batch.
import.noAccounts: You have no accounts yet. Create the account these transactions belong to first.

sharing.title: Share with other profiles
sharing.hint: A shared account appears in the selected profiles too. Its balance is one and the same; each profile sees only its own transactions on it. Nothing is shared unless you choose it here.

themes.title: Color theme
themes.contrastNote: Colors are adjusted automatically so text stays readable in light and dark mode.

autoSave.title: Automatic monthly saving
autoSave.hint: On this day each month the planned amount moves from the chosen account into the goal’s savings account (a transfer — never counted as an expense).
autoSave.needsLinked: Link the goal to a savings account to enable automatic saving.
autoSave.skipped: Automatic saving for "{{name}}" skipped — not enough balance

sync.title: Google Drive sync
sync.notConfigured: Google Drive sync is not set up in this copy of the app
sync.notConfiguredHint: The app owner must add a Google OAuth client ID (VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID) and publish the app on its own web address. Until then, use encrypted backup files.
sync.step1Hint: The app asks only for its own hidden folder in your Drive. It cannot see your other files.
sync.createHint: Your data is encrypted with this password before it leaves the phone — Google cannot read it. You will type it on each phone you connect.
sync.joinHint: This Google account already holds synced data. Enter the sync password you created on your other phone.
sync.mergeWarning: This phone already has its own data. It will be combined with the data in Drive. Starter categories may appear twice — you can delete the extra ones.
sync.replaceNote: This phone has no accounts or transactions yet, so it will take the data from Drive.
sync.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. It cannot be recovered — if you lose it, your Drive copy cannot be opened (your phone data is not affected).
sync.reenterHint: This phone needs the sync password again (for example after the app lock was removed).

status.ok: Up to date. Syncs automatically while the app is open.
status.needsAuth: Google sign-in expired (it lasts about an hour). Tap Reconnect to continue syncing.
status.needsPassword: Sync password needed on this phone.
status.error: Last sync failed: {{reason}} — it will retry automatically.

sync.conflictsHint: The same record was changed on two phones. The newer change was kept and nothing was thrown away — you can switch to the other version.
sync.switched: Switched to the other version; it will sync to your other phones.
sync.restorePointsHint: A full encrypted copy is saved to Drive once a day; the last 7 are kept.
sync.rollBackBody: Your data on every connected phone will return to how it was on {{date}}. Later changes are removed. Consider making a backup file first.
sync.rolledBack: Rolled back. Your other phones follow on their next sync.
sync.disconnectHint: Your data on this phone always stays.
sync.keepBody: This phone stops syncing. The encrypted copy in Drive stays for your other phones.
sync.eraseBody: The encrypted copy and all restore points in Drive are deleted permanently. Other phones will stop syncing. Data on this phone stays.
sync.how1: Each person uses their own Google account — there is no shared server.
sync.how2: Everything is encrypted on the phone with your sync password before upload.
sync.how3: Sync runs when the app is open: on start, every few minutes and after changes. Android does not let web apps sync in the background when closed.
sync.how4: Edits on two phones never overwrite silently: the newer one wins and the other is kept for review.

banner.auth: Google sign-in expired — tap to reconnect sync
banner.password: Sync needs your sync password on this phone
banner.failing: Sync keeps failing — tap for details

err.short: The sync password must be at least 8 characters.
err.foreign: The Drive folder holds data from another app.
err.newer: Drive data was written by a newer version of the app. Update this app first.
err.forbidden: Google refused access. Reconnect and allow Drive access.
err.remoteGone: The Drive copy was erased. Stop syncing and connect again.
err.cannotRestore: That version cannot be restored because its file is not on this phone.
err.popupBlocked: The Google window was blocked. Allow pop-ups for this app and try again.
err.popupClosed: The Google window was closed before finishing.
err.scope: Please tick the Google Drive permission to sync.
err.load: Could not load Google sign-in. Check your connection.
